name: pico-runtime-contract-v1
description: Frozen deterministic, paired runtime-contract cases for context budgeting, duplicate read evidence, checkpoint validation, and mutating tool failures. This suite has no remote model calls.

acceptance: The control prompt is measurably over the fixed 220-token budget.
The candidate prompt is within budget.
The candidate keeps the complete current request without truncation.
The candidate records reduction of old context before current-request clipping.
The identical scripted read sequence performs all three physical reads in the control.
The candidate performs two physical reads, blocking exactly one unchanged duplicate.
The blocked duplicate returns cached evidence to the scripted model.
A workspace write invalidates the guard and permits a fresh read of changed content.
An unchanged checkpoint restores as full-valid and is rendered into the resumed prompt.
A changed tracked file produces partial-stale and removes its stale summary.
Approval-policy and step-budget drift produce workspace-mismatch with both fields named.
An incompatible checkpoint schema produces schema-mismatch.
Latest-session selection excludes delegate and malformed session entries.
A non-mutating non-zero shell exit is classified as error.
The same non-zero exit with a workspace write is classified as partial_success.
The partial-success record retains affected paths, a diff summary, and a process note.
